I booked the flights through Icelandair back in early March. Round trip to Reykjavik, departing May 18th, coming back May 25th.
The tickets cost about $640 per person.
The booking reference is IKXR47.
I settled on a small guesthouse near Vik called Black Beach Guesthouse. It only has six rooms, which is exactly what I wanted—no big resort energy.
I ended up pushing the return to May 26th because I want an extra day near the Snæfellsnes Peninsula. So scratch May 25th, the return flight is now May 26th.
I want to visit a hidden hot spring called Seljavallalaug—it's a natural pool tucked into a valley, not one of those commercial ones.
Budget-wise, I'm aiming for about $3,200 total for both of us, not counting the flights since those are already paid.
I'm drawn to simple local restaurants—fresh fish, lamb stew, that kind of thing. Not interested in trendy New Nordic tasting menus at all.
records.value: simple local restaurants, fresh fish, lamb stew

records.source_span: My sister is coming back from her Portugal trip on May 28th too. She's flying into the same airport as us, just a different terminal.
My friend Dana, who's been to like 30 countries, told me the Golden Circle tour is overrated and too touristy. She said the Westfjords are way better if you want actual quiet.
I just changed the return flight again—moved it to May 28th. My partner got two extra days off work approved, so we're extending.
I looked into a side trip to the Faroe Islands earlier, but the logistics were a nightmare and the inter-island flights were weirdly expensive, so I dropped that idea entirely. It's just Iceland now.
I still need to sort out travel insurance. My partner reminded me about it; he's better at that administrative stuff than I am.
Dana told me that Dana's colleague extended her Iceland trip to May 30th because she found cheap last-minute accommodation in Akureyri.
records.value: extended to May 30th, staying in Akureyri

records.source_span: My partner mentioned that Raj got back from Tromsø on May 26th. Apparently he had a great time but wished he'd stayed longer. He was also flying through Keflavík on a connection, funny enough.

So I've been looking at the budget breakdown more carefully. With ten days and the car rental, I think we'll be right around $3,200 if we're careful.

I found a decent car rental deal for about $65 per day through a local company.
Icelandair confirmed we can push the return all the way to May 30th for only a $40 fee.
My partner's manager said the extra days are basically approved, just waiting on the formal sign-off.

records.source_span: So the May 30th extension isn't happening after all. His manager came back and said only the original two extra days were approved. So we're sticking with May 28th—that's the final return date.
